findings.claim: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) — introduced by Anthropic in 2024 and now adopted by OpenAI and Google — standardises how agents connect to tools.
findings.issue: Accurate as stated (Anthropic introduced MCP in November 2024; OpenAI adopted it in March 2025 and Google in April 2025). Worth knowing for completeness: in December 2025 Anthropic donated MCP to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (co-founded with OpenAI and Block), so it is no longer solely an Anthropic-governed project. This does not falsify any claim in the content, but the governance change could be reflected in a future revision.

findings.claim: As one industry guide puts it, an AI assistant is reactive... an AI agent 'can take actions automatically based on triggers without human prompting.'
findings.issue: The quote is attributed to an unnamed 'industry guide' with no identifiable source or link. Not a factual error, but the attribution is unverifiable. Consider naming the source or removing the quotation framing.

findings.claim: Gartner predicts that by 2026, 40% of enterprise applications will include task-specific AI agents.
findings.issue: Accurate, but Gartner's prediction (Aug 2025 press release) specifies 'by the end of 2026, up from less than 5% in 2025.' The article omits the baseline comparison; the headline figure and year are correct. Adding 'up from less than 5%' would improve fidelity but the claim as stated is not wrong.
